verdicts.reason: A and B are pixel-identical. Both cut the barrel photo down to a small, unrecognisable sliver at the far left, and the triangle logo shrinks to an icon you can barely see wedged against it. A stray black bar (the leftover divider or image) sits above 'Discover the difference', butting into the tagline, which wraps awkwardly into a cramped two-line block on the right. The warm texture and airy feel of the original are lost; only the wordmark reads well.
